name: electron-wrapper
description: A GENERIC Electron wrapper (ES modules): a template + registered tabs. Register tabs (name + path — a div/iframe to any API-rendered page), menus (label→function), and the wrapper ships its own app tray (default on; icon as input; a menu tree with matching onclick). Events go out through an event-handler instance ('app closed' included); optional per-tab state pulling (solid · highlighted · flashing). The wrapper wraps — it decides nothing; content-blind.

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run selftest
